changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwfinancialdocumentitems AS SELECT fdi.id, fdi.document_id, fdi.patient_service_product_id, fdi.quantity, fdi.unit_price, fdi.gross_amount, fdi.discount_amount, fdi.tax_amount, fdi.net_amount, fdi.patient_share_amount, fdi.insurance_share_amount, fdi.created_by, fdi.created_date, fdi.last_modified_by, fdi.last_modified_date, fdi.paid_amount, fdi.remaining_amount, fdi.insurance_paid_amount, fdi.insurance_remaining_amount, fdi.status, fdi.currency, fdi.billing_charge_line_id, fdi.parent_document_item_id, fdi.item_code, fdi.item_description, fdi.adjustment_action, fdi.pricing_adjustment_snapshot FROM public.financial_document_items fdi;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwfinancialdocumentitems TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwfinancialdocumentitems FROM report_user;
